verdict: No introduced source blocker in the two-file extraction under the documented cooperative-lock model.
checks: Every transition is a commit with the exact observed remote head as parent; ordinary nonforce pushes reject sibling competitors. Initial unrelated roots likewise produce one successful creator.
Reads validate the exact fixed ref, fetch the observed immutable commit without tags/submodules/FETCH_HEAD writes, and fail closed on malformed state.
Configured read and push destinations must be the same single remote URL; argv execution avoids shell interpolation.
Exact owner/token and unexpired monotonic clock checks precede authority assertions and heartbeat; expiry alone never permits takeover.
Push explicitly disables followTags; exact refspec confines transitions to metadata branch.
Ten original tests use real bare repositories and pre-receive race barriers; assert main remains unchanged and annotated tags remain local.
limits: This is cooperative exclusion, not adversarial authorization: owner/token values are readable metadata.
The tool does not interpose on arbitrary shared-branch writes. The coordinator must assertOwned before mutation and separately enforce current target head, CI and review.
Source review only by this worker; the coordinator executes original Git tests. No live remote lock transition performed by this reviewer.
